name: sgs/before-after
title: Before / After
description: Two-media comparison slider with a draggable divider. Each side (before/after) independently chooses image / video / SVG via `beforeMediaType`/`afterMediaType` — mirroring sgs/media's mediaType fork applied per comparison slot. Works with zero JavaScript for the image/SVG case — both slots are always present in the markup and a CSS-only clip-path renders the configured default position; JS progressively enhances the divider into a live drag (native range input for keyboard + touch, GSAP Draggable for free-drag directly on the media) and, when either slot is video, drives synchronised play/pause + drift-corrected currentTime across both `<video>` elements. Video slots support WP-library uploads and direct MP4/WebM URLs ONLY — YouTube/Vimeo embeds are deliberately unsupported here because a cross-origin iframe cannot be kept in sync without loading each platform's external player SDK (Spec 38 three-tier motion doctrine: no CDN-loaded third-party script). `orientation` (horizontal/vertical) crossed with `reverseDirection` gives all four reveal directions — after-on-left (default), after-on-right, after-on-top, after-on-bottom — with the label order and clip-path both keyed off the same two attributes so a label never sits over the wrong media. Content-KIND, block-private (no SGS_Container_Wrapper) — box + width only, matches the sgs/quote / sgs/button pattern (D294).

labelBackground.reason: The before/after caption label overlay is aria-hidden with pointer-events:none — no :hover CSS targets it anywhere. Already correctly painted via sgs_block_background_layer_css()/sgs_background_paint_decl() with a real gradient attribute wired. Confirmed 2026-09-06 (colour-conformance FILL audit).

sgs._comment_mediaElements: One media slot per side (Spec 49 §10.4): Source, Alt and Decorative, Fit, Focal and Playback each, printed by the shared renderer. The frame's own height, maxWidth and borderRadius are the Height, Width and Radius both sides share.

frame.label: Frame
frame._note_shadow_hover: boxShadowHover added 2026-09-07 (hover SHAPE capability, Bean's shape+colour-per-state ruling) — sibling of the pre-existing boxShadowColourHover, which was declared as an attribute but had no attrMap entry until now. Composed together by sgs_shadow_decls() in render.php (map key 'hover'), mirroring sgs/button's boxShadow/boxShadowHover pair.

label.label: Labels
label._note: 'fill' cluster added 2026-08-15 so labelBackgroundColour (previously an unclaimed style-defect orphan) resolves via the default convention: label + BackgroundColour. labelColour already resolved fine under 'text' (css:color, suffix Colour). Gradient siblings for both added 2026-09-04 as explicit attrMap entries (the default convention's suffix table doesn't cover *ColourGradient/*BackgroundColourGradient) — labelBackgroundColourGradient moved to its own ::after layer (sgs_block_background_layer_css()) to free the element's background-image for labelColourGradient's background-clip:text.
label._note_bg: labelBackgroundColour declared 2026-09-05: read at render.php:141 and painted as the label's own background. render.php:283 records it was deliberately moved OFF the shared mechanism, which is why nothing declared it and it showed as a rogue seed.

divider-line.label: Divider line
divider-line._note: The visible divider stroke rendered inside the divider assembly (`.wp-block-sgs-before-after__divider-line`, render.php line 558) — a child of the `divider` element's positioning wrapper, NOT the same node. dividerColour/dividerWidth were previously misattributed as orphans under `divider` by simple prefix-string matching (both names literally start with 'divider'); this explicit attrMap claims them on their real owning element instead, clearing both from the conformance style-defect count. css:width is used for the line's thickness (DB records the underlying CSS as a height+width shorthand); no dedicated stroke-thickness member exists in the taxonomy, so css:width/layout is the nearest honest mapping. Found live 2026-08-15: DB tagged 2 attrs css_element='divider-line', undeclared until now. dividerColourHover/dividerColourHoverGradient (2026-09-06, FILL closeout) added the divider line's own hover state — mirrors the handle's hover-state shape on the sibling `handle` element below.

handle.label: Handle
handle._note: The draggable divider handle/grip (`.wp-block-sgs-before-after__handle`, render.php line 559). handleColour paints its background. handleIconColour styles the icon's SVG stroke — a property with no cluster-member analogue anywhere in cluster-member-sets.json (no css:stroke member exists in the current taxonomy), so it is deliberately left unclustered rather than force-fit into background-color. `prefix: ""` opts this element out of orphan-candidate scanning so handleIconColour is reported honestly as an accepted gap (adding a css:stroke member is a framework-level taxonomy change, out of scope for a single block's manifest). Found live 2026-08-15: DB tagged 2 attrs css_element='handle', undeclared until now. 2026-09-05 (svg-paint-gradient end-shape): handleIconColourGradient added as the FIRST svg-paint-gradient row in the framework — resolved via sgs_svg_stroke_gradient() (same mechanism as sgs/icon's iconColourGradient), never the background-image custom-property-gradient pattern used elsewhere on this same block, because a stroke gradient needs a real SVG <linearGradient>/<radialGradient> def, not a CSS background paint. css:stroke/css:stroke-gradient entries added here rather than to cluster-member-sets.json (still no framework-wide stroke-gradient vocabulary member — same scope boundary as the note above). handleIconColourHover/handleIconColourHoverGradient (2026-09-06, colour-conformance closeout) resolved via the shared sgs_icon_gradient_css() composer, source-aware (lucide/wp-icon).

labelColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of labelColourHover. Non-empty wins over labelColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

reverseDirection._comment: Crossed with orientation to give all 4 reveal directions. false (default, UNCHANGED — Bean-locked): horizontal reveals after on the LEFT, vertical reveals after on the TOP. true: horizontal reveals after on the RIGHT (the more common slider convention), vertical reveals after on the BOTTOM. style.css keys both the clip-path AND the label order off this same attribute so a direction change can never reintroduce the 2026-07-31 label-vs-image mismatch (labels + clip must always move together).

freeDrag._comment: When true, GSAP Draggable enhances the divider so the visitor can drag anywhere on the image, on top of the always-present native range input (keyboard + native touch drag + no-JS-safe). When false, only the native range input drives the divider — still fully operable, just without the free-drag-on-image layer.

dividerColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting via background-image (helpers-tokens.php sgs_custom_property_gradient_decls). Non-empty wins over dividerColour.

dividerColourHover.description: Divider-line background colour on :hover/:focus-visible (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06) — mirrors handleColourHover's shape. The divider line has no interaction of its own, so the trigger is the same range-hover ancestor chain style.css already uses for the handle's scale transform. Falls back to dividerColour, then the CSS default, when unset.

dividerColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the divider-line's :hover background. Non-empty wins over dividerColourHover; falls back to dividerColourGradient, then none.

handleColourHover.description: Handle background colour on :hover/:focus-visible (colour-conformance FILL closeout 2026-09-06) — the handle's icon already had a hover stroke override; its own background never did. Falls back to handleColour, then the CSS default, when unset.

handleColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the handle's :hover background. Non-empty wins over handleColourHover; falls back to handleColourGradient, then none.

handleIconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the handle icon's SVG stroke via a real <linearGradient>/<radialGradient> def (sgs_svg_stroke_gradient(), same mechanism as sgs/icon's iconColourGradient) rather than the background-image custom-property pattern used elsewhere on this block (D636 gradient rollout, extended 2026-09-05 — the ONLY svg-paint-gradient row in the framework at the time this was added). Non-empty wins over handleIconColour at paint time.

handleIconColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the handle icon's SVG stroke on hover, resolved via the shared sgs_icon_gradient_css() composer. Non-empty wins over handleIconColourHover at paint time.

handleIconSource.description: IconPicker source for the draggable handle's icon glyph (2026-09-05 migration off the hand-rolled two-polyline SVG onto the shared Lucide+IconPicker mechanism, matching sgs/icon's iconSource/iconName pair). All four IconPicker sources (lucide, wp-icon, dashicon, emoji) are supported — sgs_icon_gradient_css() (helpers-svg-gradient.php) routes the gradient per source: a real SVG stroke gradient for lucide/wp-icon, background-clip:text (+ an @supports fallback rule) for the dashicon/emoji text glyphs, exactly like sgs/icon's own iconSource/iconColourGradient pair. (2026-09-05 note this attribute previously carried an enum restricting it to lucide/wp-icon only, on the reasoning that dashicon/emoji have no SVG stroke for a gradient to paint — that restriction was agreed-obsolete and reverted 2026-09-08 once the shared composer's text-glyph branch existed.) Defaults to 'lucide' + handleIconName='chevrons-left-right' so every existing instance renders visually unchanged.

handleIconName.description: Lucide/wp-icon/dashicon slug, OR the literal emoji character when handleIconSource='emoji' — IconPicker stores a single { source, name } pair for all four sources (name is the emoji glyph itself for the emoji source, same convention as sgs/icon). Default 'chevrons-left-right' matches the previously hand-rolled two-polyline chevron SVG exactly — no visual regression on un-migrated instances.

boxShadowHover.description: Hover-state shadow SHAPE sibling of boxShadow. Composed with boxShadowColourHover (falls back to boxShadowColour) at render time via sgs_shadow_decls().

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border with a masked ring instead of a flat colour (D636 border-gradient rollout). Non-empty wins over borderColour.
